title: Koala reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='20' fill='#9DAAB6'/>

  <circle cx='31' cy='32' r='11' fill='#8C9BA8'/>

  <circle cx='31' cy='32' r='6' fill='#D4B8A8'/>

  <!-- Book cover edge left -->
  <path d='M22 68 Q36 62 50 66 L50 66 Q36 62 22 68 Z' fill='#D4A06A'/>
  <!-- Book cover edge right -->
  <path d='M78 68 Q64 62 50 66 L50 66 Q64 62 78 68 Z' fill='#C4905A'/>

  <line x1='27' y1='72' x2='46' y2='70' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='27' y1='80' x2='46' y2='78' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='54' y1='70' x2='73' y2='72' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='74' x2='73' y2='76' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='78' x2='73' y2='80' stroke='#A08060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='26' cy='72' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#9DAAB6'/>
  <!-- Right paw holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='72' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#9DAAB6'/>

  <circle cx='29' cy='70' r='1.2' fill='#5A6878'/>
  <!-- Right paw claws -->

  <circle cx='74' cy='69' r='1.2' fill='#5A6878'/>

  <!-- Cheek blush right -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='54' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#E0A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>
